description: This file defines the ConsistencyTestOptions class and the ReadWriteDetermination enum, which are used to configure consistency testing parameters in Orleans transactions.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestOptions
classes.description: A class representing configuration options for consistency testing, including seed, number of grains, depth, deadlock and timeout avoidance flags, read/write determination mode, and grain offset.

methods.name: ConsistencyTestOptions
methods.description: Constructor for the ConsistencyTestOptions class, implicitly defined by the class.
